blocks.text: Gridline Analytics, Inc. is a Detroit based business that employs approximately 11 people.
Gridline Analytics develops cloud software that helps municipal transit agencies schedule routes and forecast ridership. The company was founded in 2024 and sells annual subscriptions.

Priya Raman — CEO. Former transit data scientist.
Marcus Bell — CTO. Software engineer, 10 years.
Motor City Seed Fund — Investor.
Revenues increased 160.0%, from $450,000 in FYE 12/31/24 to $1.170M during FYE 12/31/25.
Cost of Goods Sold have steadily decreased during the periods reviewed (from 22% of sales during FYE 12/31/24 to 20% of sales during FYE 12/31/25).
The margins for net income and EBITDA have varied (net income between -185% to -28% of sales, while EBITDA has maintained a margin of between -183% to -26% of sales).
Cash flows were not sufficient to service the obligations of the Borrower in every period. DSCR was -8.06x and -3.01x during FYE 12/31/24 and 12/31/25, respectively.

Net worth declined from $766,500 to $441,500 over the period. Total liabilities have changed materially over the periods reviewed and leverage (debt to worth) is increasing (0.07x to 0.16x). Please see Exhibit D - Historical Statements of Assets, Liabilities and Net Worth for further detail.

Historical operations have not generated enough cash flow to cover the proposed debt service in every year. For DSCR to reach 1.00x, sales would need to increase 263.1% and 43.7% in FYE 12/31/24 and FYE 12/31/25, respectively. Our model adjusts the cost of goods sold so that gross profit margins are consistent with historical levels. Operating expenses are treated as a fixed cost and are not adjusted to sales.
